instruction: Okay, now you are in the kitchen area facing towards the white cupboards. Go straight near to the white cupboards passing the sink platform, which is on left side. Now turn to your left and move towards the table in front of you, now you are standing in front of the table and next to the refrigerator, which is on the right side. Now slightly turn to your right and forward, now you are facing towards an open entrance, go straight through that open entrance and exit the room. Now you are standing on the mat at the entrance, turn to your left and enter the room. Now you are standing on another mat at the entrance. Now in front of you there is a table with three bar stools, walk all the way straight passing the table with bar stools on the left side. Now slightly turn to your left and in front of you there is a narrow passage adjacent to the white cupboards, walk through that passage. Slightly turn to your left and in front of you, sorry on the left side there is an open entrance opposite to the portrait, which is on the wall. Enter through that open entrance, now you are facing towards the wall, turn to your left and enter the room through the opened door in front of you. Now you are standing in the room facing towards two beds, turn to your right and move forward. Now you are standing at the entrance of an opened door, turn to your right and enter the room. Now you are in the washroom standing at the entrance of the shower room, and that is the end point.
